fixed.geometry: EPSG6933; simplify30 m preserve_topology; buffer quad_segs2; polygon interior included; pixel-centre rasterization
fixed.original_study: Fixed mapped study footprint and region assignments used for the historical analysis
fixed.grid: 30 m EPSG6933 globally aligned, 900 m2 per centre, unique1024x1024 owned cores
fixed.local_neighbourhood: 500 m ground radius and four-neighbour geometry; original kernel reused per original block
fixed.aggregation: Mean unnormalized S across annual valid unique equal-area reference centres, followed by fixed normalization; the resulting final UMRI score is reported directly
fixed.observations: Annual winner selection, QA, classification ensemble and spectral transformations are identical across buffer distances.
fixed.missing: Source not acquired differs from annual observation missing; no temporal infill; invalid classes0 are unknown; mapped absence is an ecological zero where formula specifies

report: Annual overall and ten-region UMRI, five weighted component means, valid support, endpoint direction and continuous annual-trajectory comparison.
scope: Annual 2000-2025 UMRI under the same selected cities with 1-, 2- and 5-km buffers, intersected with the original mapped study footprint.
population_relationship: The 1-km and 2-km domains use the same annual states on their respective reference subsets. The 5-km domain includes the 2-km reference and additional centres, each evaluated with its 500-m neighbourhood.
